confidence_notes: Meal, beer and coffee anchors draw on search results reporting Numbeo's crowd-sourced Matsuyama page (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Matsuyama-Japan, Jan 2026 snapshot: inexpensive meal JPY 1,000; mid-range meal for two JPY 5,000; draft beer JPY 326; cappuccino JPY 370; wide ranges). I blended these with Numbeo's Japan-wide averages (beer and cappuccino about JPY 500) and nudged beer, coffee and the mid-range meal slightly above the thin local entries. Yen prices were converted at roughly JPY 158-160 per USD, implied by Numbeo's USD display (not an official rate). No aggregated Matsuyama cocktail or wine price was found. Both are inferred from the beer relationship (about 1.6x and 1.5x) and general knowledge of Japanese izakaya/bar pricing, so they are the least certain food and drink anchors. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or listings were searched or inspected. The RBA figure (18 Nov 2026) comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not open directly. The 19 Nov rate was not yet available.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japanese regional city on Shikoku with moderate tourism around Dogo Onsen. Food and drink are priced from Numbeo's Matsuyama and Japan-wide figures, below Tokyo/Osaka levels. Lodging is benchmarked by analogy to similar regional cities such as Takamatsu or Kumamoto (general knowledge, not searched).
